concepts.def: Health: staying well, common illnesses and visiting the doctor, a core wellbeing topic.
Diet and eating habits, including healthy and unhealthy food choices, e.g. 'manger équilibré'.
Physical activity and exercise, and how regular sport benefits health and wellbeing.
Wellbeing, including mental health, stress and relaxation, and how to look after yourself.
Sleep and rest as part of a healthy lifestyle, e.g. getting enough hours each night.
Expressing obligation and advice for healthy living, e.g. 'on doit manger des fruits', 'il faut faire du sport'.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 2: Lifestyle and Wellbeing — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 2: Lifestyle and Wellbeing brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 2: Lifestyle and Wellbeing.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence gives healthy-living advice correctly?
options: Il faut manger des fruits et des légumes.
Il faut mange des fruits.
Il faut à manger fruits.
Il faut des manger légumes.
To eat a balanced diet
To skip meals
To eat only sweets
To cook professionally
Wellbeing
A bank
A sport stadium
Homework

mcqs.q: Which is part of a healthy lifestyle?
options: Faire de l'exercice régulièrement
Fumer tous les jours
Ne jamais dormir
Manger trop de sucre

mcqs.q: How do you give advice with 'il faut'?
options: Il faut + infinitive, e.g. 'il faut manger des fruits'
Il faut + 'je' form
Ne jamais dormir
Il faut des manger
